name: Golden Mountains of Altai
description: In southern Siberia, the Golden Mountains of Altai bring together three protected areas: the deep Lake Teletskoye, the glaciated peak of Mount Belukha, and the high Ukok plateau. Climbing through them, you pass from open steppe through forest and subalpine meadow to alpine terrain. The mountains feed the Ob and Irtysh rivers and shelter rare snow leopards.
